terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Use measurable 3D graphics terms. Avoid vague words unless they are paired with concrete geometry/material/shader parameters.

referenceCamera.note: For likeness work, solve the reference camera (forge/stage1_intake/solve_camera_pose.py) so the review render aligns with the photo and the reference can be projected. Confirm by overlay review.

objectClass.primaryType: red silk Chinese hanging lantern with gold caps, a wire hook and a tassel
motionPotential: swings on its hook, but as a whole rigid body - nothing articulates
objectClass.notes: The Yaowarat and Chinese-shrine lantern, hung in pairs beside a door and in rows under an awning. Radially symmetric, so the single view shows the whole form and the usual hidden-back-side uncertainty does not apply here.

reasoning: Two drawn parts, which is the entire medium-class ceiling: the lathed body and the tassel.
A surface of revolution is exactly a lathe, and the body's gold caps are a COLOUR change on the same surface, so they are vertex-colour bands rather than a third part or a third material.

The lantern's vertical ribs are NOT built: at 0.38 m across, seen from a metre away in a level, they are a shading detail, and a repetition system for them would cost the second draw call the tassel needs.
It hangs, so the pivot is at top-center and the whole prop occupies negative Y.

specDepthDecision.rationale: Moderate. The medium class allows only TWO draw calls and TWO materials, so all sub-structure is carried as lathe profile detail, vertex-colour regions and localFeatures.

detailInventory.note: Enumerate every identity-defining small detail before authoring the spec. Each detail must map to a component.localFeatures entry or material.localOverrides entry, never prose only. Use forge/stage1_intake/build_detail_inventory.py to scan zones.

details.description: A plump barrel bulging to r 0.19 at the equator and closing to 0.072 at both caps.
Sixteen vertical seams, darker than the panels between them.
A gilt cap and collar at both ends of the silk.
A bound cord and tapering tuft below the bottom cap, setting the declared height.
A wire hook at the top-center pivot.
Silk authored at luma 37 so it RENDERS near 48, the harness having a measured gain of about 1.29 over albedo.
A collar ring under each gilt cap where the crimp grips the silk.

anatomy.note: Only meaningful when objectClass.primaryDomain is character or hybrid. Set applies=true and fill from forge/stage1_intake/extract_landmarks.py. See grimoire/character/reconstruction.md and grimoire/character/likeness_maximization.md.

resolvedUnknowns: Radially symmetric, so nothing is hidden by the single view. Confidence 0.95.

The gold characters printed on the plate's lantern are NOT reproduced: they are a printed graphic, and the kit's route for one is a post-construction canvas, which is not justified on a 0.38 m prop at two draw calls. Confidence 0.9.
Rib count is not resolvable and is not built. Confidence 0.7.
preSpecAssessment.unknownsNote: All intake unknowns are RESOLVED; each has a chosen answer and a stated confidence in resolvedUnknowns and in spec.assumptions. Nothing here blocks implementation, and the ones a second view would settle are not resolvable from a single plate by any amount of further analysis.

definitionOfDone: The rendered model matches the reference silhouette, primary proportions, visible component hierarchy, material response, and most recognizable local features for the selected fidelity tier.

featureGroups.name: Overall silhouette and proportions
qualityCriteria: Bounding shape, dominant curves, negative spaces, and scale relationships are explicitly described.
failureModes: model reads as a generic placeholder instead of the reference object
major proportions are guessed without evidence

featureGroups.name: Primary structure and hierarchy
qualityCriteria: Major parts, joints, seams, contact points, and parent-child relationships are named before code generation.
failureModes: large visible parts are merged into one mesh
component hierarchy is too shallow for the observed complexity

featureGroups.name: Attachment and joint correctness
qualityCriteria: Every visible child appendage, branch, limb, handle, connector, tube, cable, horn, wing, leg, or hinged part has an attachment contract with parent socket, localStart/localEnd, contact type, embed/overlap, and gap tolerance.
failureModes: child part root floats away from the parent
branch/limb/tube is centered in space instead of pivoting from its root
parent-child transform mixes world and local coordinates

featureGroups.name: Surface material response
qualityCriteria: Albedo zones, roughness, normal/bump/displacement intent, cavity dirt, edge wear, and local overrides are specified where visible.
Important materials define independent albedo, roughness, height/normal, and AO responses instead of reusing one texture for unrelated PBR channels.
Surface response is decomposed into macro, meso, and micro frequency bands with scale and amplitude tied to object scale.
failureModes: local material variation is missing or not tied to image evidence

featureGroups.name: Reference color, material, and lighting response
qualityCriteria: Material-pass names the reference-derived albedo palette, roughness variation, tactile normal/bump/displacement response, and local masks.
When a source image is available, run reference PBR extraction and require confidence >= 0.7 before treating maps as implementation-ready.
Lighting-pass names key/fill/rim or environment light, exposure, tone mapping, background, and contact shadow behavior.
Neutral, grazing-angle, and reference-matched renders prove that surface relief survives relighting and is not painted into albedo.
failureModes: model has acceptable shape but reads as flat shaded or plastic
colors are a generic average instead of reference-observed local color zones
lighting is evenly ambient and cannot reproduce the source value range

visualDeltaChecks: bbox against 0.38 x 0.62 x 0.38 m and hanging entirely below y=0
turntable hole gate at all four azimuths
gilt collars readable as two distinct bands
antiShallowSpecRules: Every identity-defining detail in the inventory maps to a named localFeature, a vertexPaint region or a repetitionSystem - never to prose alone.
Every material carries a measured crop as textureless evidence.
Every geometric figure is measured off the plate, measured off the proxy band table, or derived from the declared envelope, and says which.
mustNotDo: Do not lift the silk toward grey to clear the hole gate - it clears on chroma, and lifting destroys the prop's identity.
Do not build rib seams or printed characters; both are recorded omissions at this budget.
Do not put a sharp corner in the lathe profile - a shared disc/wall vertex shades as a dark ring the gate reads as a hole.
Do not add a second pivot or any socket.
qualityContract.depthRationale: TWO components across two material layers. Six micro-feature groups: the belly profile, the stitched seams, the two gold caps, the tassel and the hanging hook.

mustMatch: reference-derived PBR material response at or above 0.7 confidence when source pixels are usable
niceToHave: micro scratches, stains, chips, and dirt masks

visualAcceptance.scoringRule: AI vision must inspect a side-by-side reference/render sheet and score the current pass from 0 to 1. Pixel-diff code may assist diagnostics but cannot approve a pass.

featureReviewPolicy.selectionRule: Choose only the most visually salient, identity-defining, user-prioritized, or high-risk semantic systems. Group repeated parts instead of reviewing every mesh. AI vision scores every selected feature from the same full reference/render pair.

specRefineTriggers: local feature not traceable to viewEvidence
codeRefineTriggers: spec is adequate but generated geometry/material does not match
lighting hides geometry or material response
stopCriteria: target fidelity reached or user accepts current approximation
remaining gaps require new reference images or manual art

screenshotPolicy.minimumEvidence: Each visual pass needs a reference image, rendered screenshot, side-by-side comparison sheet, AI vision score, layer scores, and critique before choosing continue.
screenshotPolicy.reviewPairRule: Compare the same camera/viewpoint whenever possible; do not judge a front reference against a random render angle.
screenshotPolicy.acceptanceAuthority: AI vision review of the comparison sheet. Code-generated pixel similarity is not sufficient evidence.

featureReviewTargets.name: Overall silhouette and the declared envelope
featureReviewTargets.criteria: Measured bbox must be 0.38 x 0.62 x 0.38 m within tolerance, hanging entirely below y=0 from a top-center pivot.

featureReviewTargets.name: Lantern belly profile
featureReviewTargets.criteria: A plump ribbed barrel with sixteen vertical seams. A smooth ellipsoid fails -- that is what the previous build shipped.

featureReviewTargets.name: Gilt collars
featureReviewTargets.criteria: Gilt caps at BOTH ends, plus a tassel of cord and tuft below the lower one. One band and a bare cone fails.

featureReviewTargets.name: Material response and the CHROMA hole gate
featureReviewTargets.criteria: The silk must stay strongly saturated. This prop renders within ~20 luma of the backdrop, so the turntable gate must be cleared on chroma; if the answer to a hole finding here is to lift the red toward grey, the answer is wrong.

lookDevTargets.keyLightIntent: Hemisphere light plus three directionals, ACES tone mapping, no environment map.
lookDevTargets.materialSeparation: silk 69-76 / gilt collars 123 / tassel 42 in measured plate luma - the whole prop sits close to the 58 backdrop in luma and far from it in chroma.
lookDevTargets.holeGateFloor: No surface may render at or near the ~58 backdrop luma at any turntable azimuth, including the back-lit 180 frame which renders at ~0.55 of painted luma.
lookDevTargets.notes: Metalness is held below 1.0 on every metal because there is no environment map to reflect.

actionReadiness.notes: Explodable and clickable as two named parts. Not articulated and not breakable.

assumptions: Radially symmetric, so nothing is hidden by the single view.
The vertical rib seams are NOT built as geometry - a shading detail at 0.38 m, and a repetition system for them would cost the tassel's draw call.
The gold characters printed on the plate are NOT reproduced: a printed graphic would need a post-construction canvas, which is not justified at two draw calls on a 0.38 m prop.
The silk and tassel are authored SATURATED rather than lifted toward grey; this prop clears the hole gate on chroma, not luma.
The lantern is a rigid body: it swings on its hook as a whole and nothing articulates.

coordinateFrame.originPolicy: top-center: the origin sits at the hanging point on the lantern's axis, and the whole prop occupies negative Y so it hangs from a ceiling with no offset.

silhouette.derivation: Measured bbox 0.388 x 0.626 x 0.388 m against the declared 0.38 x 0.62 x 0.38 -- within 2% on all three. Width is the belly's equator, height runs from the hook at the top-center pivot to the tassel's tip.
silhouette.notes: Radially symmetric, so the single plate shows the whole form.

componentTree.name: Ribbed red silk belly
componentTree.topologyRationale: A ribbedDome, not a lathe: the seams are a modulation AROUND the axis and a lathe is constant around its own. Sixteen stitched seams on a plump barrel, the shape the plate shows between its two gold caps.

geometryDescriptor.topologyIntent: Origin TOP-CENTER at the hanging point, so the prop occupies y -0.62 to 0. A 48-segment ribbedDome over a barrel profile sampled by angle from r 0.072 at y -0.445 out to r 0.19 at the equator and back to 0.072 at y -0.055, with 16 ribs 22 mm deep.

localFeatures.description: A plump barrel bulging to r 0.19 at the equator -- the declared 0.38 m body -- and closing to r 0.072 at both caps. Sampled by angle rather than linearly so the points sit where the curvature is.

Sixteen seams as ribbedDome's crest-to-valley tint, the base hex being the silk and the valley the ratio taking it to a darker seam tone. Built GOLD first on a misreading of the plate and it rendered as an orange lantern with red stripes: the crest-to-valley blend is a smooth cosine, so two strongly different tones read as equal alternating bands rather than thin lines on a ground. The plate's gold is only the caps and the character panel.

componentTree.notes: Silk #7d0c17 with seams #560810. Both authored DARK -- see the material evidence.

colorMaterialRecipe.recipe: Red silk carrying its stitched seams as a vertex colour.

componentTree.name: Gold caps, hanging hook and the tassel
componentTree.topologyRationale: Gilt metal against silk is the prop's whole colour contrast, and the caps, hook and tassel binding are one material and therefore one submission.

geometryDescriptor.topologyIntent: A top cap and collar, a bottom cap and collar, a wire hook above, and the tassel as a bound cord and a tapering tuft reaching y -0.62.

localFeatures.description: A gold cap disc at BOTH ends, not just the top. The previous build had one band and no bottom cap.

A bound cord and a tapering tuft below the bottom cap. This is what sets the declared 0.62 m height -- the asset notes are explicit that the figure is fixture plus tassel and not the cord it hangs by. The previous build had a bare cone.
A wire hook above the top cap, at the top-center pivot.
A narrower collar ring under each cap where the crimp grips the silk. Without them the caps meet the silk as a bare disc edge and read as painted-on rather than crimped over.

componentTree.notes: Gilt #c9a227 renders at luma 178, well clear of the mask's erased window.

colorMaterialRecipe.recipe: Gilt caps and collars, with the tassel's cord carried on the same material as a vertex colour.

materials.name: Red silk lantern skin

albedo.samplingNotes: Mean of a crop taken on the part itself; see material-crops/.

evidence: THE HARNESS RENDERS BRIGHTER THAN THE ALBEDO, and that is measured, not assumed: authoring the plate's 168,17,31 came back as 204,24,45, luma 64.5, a gain of about 1.29. gatecrop's erased window of 55.5-60.5 applies to the RENDERED value, so the safe range in AUTHORED luma is roughly below 43 or above 85 -- not the below-55 that a purely multiplicative transfer would give. At the plate's own red the shaded flanks swept down through the window and the gate read 7.8% of the silhouette as holes.

Roughness 0.92 rather than 0.72: at 0.72 the silk carried a specular band up its lit meridians that rose INTO the window even with the albedo clear of it, leaving a solid 23 x 70 px strip reading as a hole. Cloth is matt anyway.

roughness.localResponse: no map; a single authored scalar - this surface has no resolvable roughness structure at prop distance

ambientOcclusion.notes: Darken seams, joints and recessed features.

localOverrides.description: Gilt collars as two vertex-colour axis-bands at the top (y -0.06..0.00) and bottom (y -0.51..-0.45) of the body, authored at #C9A16A. The generator clones a painted component's material and forces its colour to white, so vertexPaint.baseColor IS the albedo here and the band colours are final colours, not ratios.
The silk's top-to-bottom tonal drift, carried by the authored albedo rather than a synthesised map.

shaderNotes: MeshStandardMaterial is sufficient: no clearcoat, sheen or transmission is observed.
Never alias albedo into roughness; both are authored scalars, not maps.
Metalness is authored BELOW a physical raw-metal 1.0 on purpose - see notes.
materials.notes: Authored at luma 37, which renders near 48 -- close to the plate's appearance and clear of the window on every face.

materials.name: Gilt metal tassel cord and hook

albedo.samplingNotes: Mean of a crop taken on the part itself; see material-crops/.

evidence: The plate's gold appears at exactly three places -- the two caps and the character panel -- and is the only bright tone on the prop.
It renders at luma 178, well above the erased window, so no correction was needed.

roughness.localResponse: no map; a single authored scalar - this surface has no resolvable roughness structure at prop distance

ambientOcclusion.notes: Darken seams, joints and recessed features.

shaderNotes: MeshStandardMaterial is sufficient: no clearcoat, sheen or transmission is observed.
Never alias albedo into roughness; both are authored scalars, not maps.
Metalness is authored BELOW a physical raw-metal 1.0 on purpose - see notes.
materials.notes: Metalness 0.55. The tassel cord rides this material rather than the silk's so the caps and the tassel are one submission.

acceptance: Macro, meso, and repeated structures meet qualityContract.minimumSpecDepth.
Parent-child relations, joints, seams, sockets, and contact points are explicit.
Every attached child appendage/connector has parentSocket, localStart/localEnd, contactType, embedDepth or overlap, and gapTolerance.
AI vision comparison score meets selfCorrectLoop.visualAcceptance.threshold.

buildPasses.goal: Refine shape, deformation, bevels, tapers, curves, asymmetry, and visible local geometry.
acceptance: Important visible forms are represented in component geometryDescriptor, deformations, localFeatures, or repetitionSystems.
Endpoint-based child parts are rooted at their attachment sockets and do not visibly float away from parents.
AI vision comparison score meets selfCorrectLoop.visualAcceptance.threshold.

buildPasses.goal: Match material color, roughness, bump, and local variation.
acceptance: Reference-derived albedo palette records dominant, secondary, and accent colors per visible material.
Each important material defines roughness variation and at least one normal/bump/displacement response.
Local material overrides, dirt/wear/stains/moss/chips/scratches or equivalent masks are tied to evidenceRefs.
Thin, transparent, reflective, wet, or fibrous materials document alpha/transmission/clearcoat/metalness/fiber response when relevant.
Generated preview uses procedural albedo/roughness/bump texture or vertex color variation instead of one flat color.
Generated preview uses independent PBR maps at 1024px or higher for the quality-first tier.
If source pixels are available, referencePbr extraction passed at confidence >= 0.7 or the pass is stopped/requesting better references.
Macro, meso, and micro surface frequency bands are visible at the intended review distance without obvious tiling.
AI vision comparison score meets selfCorrectLoop.visualAcceptance.threshold.

buildPasses.goal: Add procedural surface locality such as normal/bump/displacement, AO, dirt, stains, chips, grain, moss, scratches, and wear.
acceptance: Every required material feature group has local overrides or surfaceDetail tied to evidenceRefs.
A grazing-angle close-up proves that normal/height detail breaks highlights naturally and does not read as smooth plastic.
AI vision comparison score meets selfCorrectLoop.visualAcceptance.threshold.

buildPasses.goal: Make material and form readable under neutral turntable lighting plus optional reference lighting.
acceptance: lightingFromPhoto identifies key light direction/color/intensity, fill light, rim or environment light, and ambient color.
Exposure, tone mapping, background color/gradient, shadow softness, and contact shadow behavior are specified.
Lighting does not hide geometry/material gaps and screenshots can be compared fairly to the reference.
Neutral, grazing, and reference-matched lighting checks distinguish material errors from lighting errors.
AI vision comparison score meets selfCorrectLoop.visualAcceptance.threshold.

buildPasses.goal: Make the model ready for future animation, transformation, physics, or destruction.
acceptance: Macro and movable meso components have stable pivot nodes.
Sockets, collider proxies, and destruction metadata are present for future runtime actions.
AI vision comparison score meets selfCorrectLoop.visualAcceptance.threshold.

buildPasses.goal: Protect runtime performance after visual fidelity is accepted.
acceptance: Triangle count, draw calls, instancing, LOD strategy, and FPS target are documented or verified.
Repeated detail is instanced or simplified where possible without breaking silhouette/material believability.

featureReviews.notes: Measured bbox 0.388 x 0.626 x 0.388 m against the declared 0.38 x 0.62 x 0.38 -- within 2% on all three axes. Width is the belly's equator; height runs from the wire hook at the top-center pivot to the tassel's tip, which is exactly how the asset notes define the figure (fixture plus tassel, not the cord).

A plump barrel sampled by angle, bulging to r 0.19 at the equator and closing to 0.072 at both caps, carrying sixteen stitched seams as a ribbedDome modulation around the axis -- which a lathe cannot do. The previous build was a smooth ellipsoid. The seams were built GOLD first on a misreading of the plate and rendered as an orange lantern with red stripes: the crest-to-valley tint is a smooth cosine, so two strongly different tones read as equal alternating bands rather than thin lines on a ground. The plate's gold is only the caps and the character panel.

A gilt cap and collar at BOTH ends of the silk, a wire hook above, and a tassel of bound cord and tapering tuft below the lower cap. The previous build had one band, no bottom cap and a bare cone for a tassel. NOT carried: the plate's gold character panel on the belly, which would need a placed decal rather than a tile -- a tile binds per material and would repeat the character around the whole body.

Two material layers. The silk's tone is SOLVED, not copied: the plate's p50 is 168,17,32 at luma 50, but authoring that came back rendered at 204,24,45, luma 64.5 -- the harness has a measured gain of about 1.29 over albedo, so gatecrop's erased 55.5-60.5 window bites on the RENDERED value and the safe authored range is below about 43 or above 85. At the plate's own red the shaded flanks swept through the window and the gate read 7.8% of the silhouette as holes. It ships authored at luma 37, rendering near 48. Roughness also went 0.72 to 0.92, because at 0.72 a specular band up the lit meridians rose into the window even with the albedo clear of it.

lodPlan.strategy: full component tree and material layers
merge static components and reduce local feature geometry

performanceBudget.optimizationPolicy: Raised to large with the lighting kit. The build measures 1072 triangles at 2 draw calls, 2 materials and 2 geometries -- half the draw-call ceiling and a quarter of the triangles. The asset notes require it to 'stay a single cheap volume' because these hang in tens under one awning, and two submissions is as close to that as a two-material prop can get.

lightingFromPhoto.observation: A soft key from the upper front-left; the belly's left side reads brighter and the gilt collar carries the strongest highlight.
lightingFromPhoto.appliesTo: review harness parity - the harness key sits at (3, 5, 4).

lightingFromPhoto.observation: Shadow sides lifted rather than black; the belly never goes fully dark.
No separate rim in the plate.
lightingFromPhoto.appliesTo: review only; the harness rim at (0, 3, -5) is a harness convention the model must not depend on.

lightingFromPhoto.observation: A mid-grey backdrop at luma ~168; foreground coverage is 22.5%. The review harness approximates it with a HemisphereLight(0xffffff, 0x404040, 1.6) and NO environment map, which is why every metal here is authored below metalness 1.0: a raw metal has no diffuse term and nothing to reflect, and it renders DARKER than the 58 backdrop, which the turntable gate reads as a hole punched through the model.

The review harness applies ACES filmic tone mapping, which rolls off highlights, so a painted luma reads lower than its raw value. Albedo is therefore verified in the render and corrected against the measurement rather than copied through from the crop.

Ambient occlusion is authored per material (cavityStrength 0.2, contactShadowBias 0.3) to darken joints and seams. The prop's ground shadow is the level bake's job, not the factory's - the factory sets castShadow/receiveShadow and nothing else.

proceduralStrategy: Create stable pivot groups, sockets, collider proxies, and destruction metadata before visual polish.
Refine forms with bevels, tapers, bends, and procedural noise.
Run reference PBR extraction for important source-image materials and stop when confidence is below the target threshold.
Add material variation before adding expensive micro-geometry.

pivots.name: Hanging point
pivots.rationale: The ONLY pivot, at the hanging point. The lantern swings as a whole rigid body; nothing inside it articulates, so a second pivot would describe a mechanism it does not have.

animationAnchors.socketsRationale: NONE, deliberately. Nothing clips onto this lantern; it hangs from its own hook, and a socket would be naming a location rather than a mechanism.

destructionAnchors: actionProfile.destruction.fractureGroup marks detachable or breakable component sets
component seams and sockets define plausible break points instead of random explosions
